rule: A redelivered checkout.session.completed grants the purchased credits once
invariant: SELECT credits <= 110 FROM users WHERE id='u1'
notes: SQL transliteration of the webhook handler; covers bounded SQL orders only, not HTTP or Stripe.

statements: WITH g AS (INSERT INTO credit_grants(stripe_session_id) VALUES ('cs_1') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING 1) UPDATE users SET credits=credits+100 WHERE id='u1' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM g)
